how: Two-lens adversarial panel (research-defender + guest-advocate) over the 59 single-pass benefit flips, plus a fresh 7-reader audit of the 308 remaining penalty zones with the same double-lens confirmation. A flip stands only if BOTH lenses uphold it. The panel refuted 34 flips: the single pass had read MITIGATION ('the horizon survives', 'milder than a nightclub') as PRAISE. The distinction that decides sign: text that praises the area or names it an exception = benefit; text that discloses a downside softened by a silver lining = penalty.
note: hump zones (24) remain benefit by Mark's direction; full panel verdicts in the wf_297ad87d-7e1 workflow journal.
